verses.1: To a man with a heart of value, and from Jehovah, there is a response.
verses.2: All the ways of a righteous man are in his eyes, and his spirit is like the spirit of the Lord.
verses.3: Turn to the LORD for your actions, and let your thoughts be corrected.
verses.4: All of Jehovah’s actions are meant to help those who are in need, and also to harm the wicked on that evil day.
verses.5: The LORD’s hatred will not be removed from any place or person. It will never be eliminated.
verses.6: In kindness and truth, fear will be eliminated, and in the sight of Jehovah, evil will be protected from us.
verses.7: If Jehovah desires a person’s path, even their enemies will be forgiven.
verses.8: It’s good to be just, but with too many people coming forward without any judgment or decision being made.
verses.9: The heart of a person should consider its own path, and God will provide the means for it to proceed.
verses.10: Kesem, on the king’s lips, cannot be praised in judgment.
verses.11: And the ears of judgment for Jehovah are like all the stones of Kish.
verses.12: The hatred of kings is caused by their evil deeds. They act unjustly, yet they still remain kings.
verses.13: Kings desire those who speak truthfully and have righteous words.
verses.14: A king’s enemy is also a man of death; and a wise man can be defeated by others.
verses.15: In the light of the king’s face, let there be life and joy for us, as a blessing from Him.
verses.16: One should choose wisely from what is good and useful, and one should also choose carefully from among the various options available.
verses.17: From evil, righteousness is separated; it preserves one’s soul. It guides one’s path.
verses.18: Before the breaking of the bread, and before its being divided into pieces.
verses.19: May good spirit free those who are oppressed from the clutches of evil.
verses.20: He is wise in matters of judgment, and he trusts in the LORD his God.
verses.21: A wise heart is like a prophet; his words are valuable and worth taking seriously.
verses.22: It brings life to those who are alive, and it destroys those who are dead.
verses.23: A wise heart will learn from its lips and from its feet.
verses.24: It is a source of comfort and healing for the soul and body.
verses.25: There is a right path before a person, and there are also wrong paths to follow.
verses.26: His soul worked hard, as if it were burdened with a heavy load.
verses.27: A man without wisdom brings harm upon himself, and his feet are like flames of fire.
verses.28: A man who is tempted will send a message, and then he will be separated from his loved ones.
verses.29: A wicked man will harm his neighbor and throw him into a bad situation.
verses.30: He turned his eyes to think about the wonders that his lips could create.
verses.31: Let her be adorned with beauty, but only in a way that is righteous.
verses.32: Good is long-lasting, even when it comes from a powerful and wise ruler. It remains beneficial even after the city has been destroyed.
verses.33: In his arms, He will hold the wicked; from Jehovah, all judgments will come.
